mo_ta_cong_viec:
EMCT focuses on digital transformation solutions for utility systems in buildings and factories, especially remote fire monitoring and control services that apply advanced digital technologies to protect lives and assets. We provide intelligent, real-time fire safety solutions for businesses and facilities across South Korea, United States, Vietnam, and other countries. Our mission is to combine advanced software platforms with strict safety standards to create a safer environment through innovation.
We are currently building our core product engineering team and are looking for a Senior Backend .NET Developer to join us. In this role, you will play a key part in developing both our SaaS systems and our core IoT platform for smart buildings.
Key Responsibilities:
Develop, maintain, and enhance backend services for SaaS systems
Build and expose RESTful APIs consumed by frontend and client applications
Ensure data integrity across core business workflows
Build scalable, real-time backend services for IoT and smart building solutions
Develop WebSocket-based communication layers for device data streaming
Design and maintain APIs for integration with IoT devices and third-party systems
Optimize backend performance and reliability for real-time IoT data processing at scale
Evolve the platform architecture to support global service expansion, including multi-region deployment and scalability across countries
Collaborate with frontend and client app teams on integration
